title: 5 Things We Learned From NBA YoungBoy’s Interview With Funny Marco
summary: Marco jetted to South Korea to meet up with the Baton Rouge rapper.
contentText:
YoungBoy Never Broke Again rarely grants interviews these days. However, Funny Marco jetted to South Korea for Marco’s first trip outside the U.S. to meet up with the reclusive rapper for an episode of his Open Thoughts series , which arrived on Tuesday (Aug. 11).

“It’s very safe here and clean,” YB said of his move to South Korea. After growing up in Baton Rouge and being held on house arrest in Utah, fans shouldn’t expect to see YoungBoy spending too much time in America in the near future.

The 26-year-old rapper opened up on a multitude of topics, including his plans when it comes to new music, touring, his relationship with his mother, medical issues and things as simple as hating hamsters.

As far as his next project, YoungBoy revealed the name of his upcoming album to be All Dogs Go to Heaven , which he expects to be released before his 27th birthday in October.

“I think I’m gonna release my album before my birthday,” YB said. “All I know is it seems like a lot of women are against me right now, like I ever gave a f–k.”

Amid his overseas travels, YoungBoy has kept busy when it comes to music. He released his Slime Cry album in January, which reached No. 6 on the Billboard 200, and didn’t waste much time following up with ML2 (More Leaks 2) in June (No. 13 peak on the Billboard 200 ).

Here are five things we learned from YoungBoy Never Broke Again’s interview with Funny Marco.
